summary: Full e2e testing of Apex Omega Final 2.0 MEV dashboard. Backend: 14/14 pytest cases pass covering health, status, graph, discovery scan, opportunities list, risk, pipeline run (C1+C2+Merkle), cycles, cycle detail, telemetry, plus 404 negative cases. Frontend: dashboard loads with glassmorphism dark UI, header telemetry + block number visible, 4-stage pipeline ribbon, opportunity matrix renders 11 rows, row selection highlights and updates detail/EV chart/Risk panel, Run Pipeline button executes full flow populating C1Panel, C2Panel (with MIRROR/REVERSE/DO_NOTHING + Merkle), ExecutionPanel and ArchivePanel. No page errors.

issues: TOTAL PROFIT often shows negative pink value due to simulated random C1 inclusion failures - by design but UX could clarify expected variance

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 940 lines single file - acceptable for MVP but consider splitting into modules (discovery.py, execution.py, math_core.py, routes.py) when adding features.
Background ticker mutates global state without lock - fine for single worker uvicorn but unsafe under multi-worker scaling.
discover_opportunities is sync and called inside async endpoint with full graph iteration; under load consider running via asyncio.to_thread.
Pipeline simulated with random.random() inclusion - non-deterministic results; consider seedable mode for tests.
`evm_mirror_validate` step_count gate always returns 2 - hardcoded; flag if route expansion is added later.
discovery/stream uses SSE but auto-scan poll is also implemented client-side; pick one to reduce duplicated load.
seed_data_creation: Tests trigger a fresh /api/discovery/scan and pipeline run; cycles + opportunities persist in MongoDB (apex_omega DB). Safe to leave for next iteration.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend uses simulated Polygon liquidity graph (no real RPC). All endpoints under /api prefix. Auto-scan runs every 5s on frontend. Pipeline candidates only contain 3 (MIRROR/REVERSE/DO_NOTHING) when C1 status == 'executed'; otherwise candidates list is empty and action is DO_NOTHING - test assertions handle both cases. Polygon RPC + Titan relay are MOCKED by design (institutional architecture demo).
mocked_apis_note: polygon-rpc-simulation and titan-bundle-submission-simulation are intentionally MOCKED per problem statement.
